items.title: Is there any place for a 14 year old to make new friends and find a/multiple hobbies?
items.author: Super_Theorist01
items.body: I’m a 14-year-old boy looking for a new hobby and hoping to make some friends outside of school. Most of my time is spent at school or sitting at home, and while I’ve tried things like writing, drawing, coding and gaming, I’d like to try something more social. I’m interested in creative stuff and meeting new people, but there seem to be both too many and too few options at the same time. Does anyone know of any clubs, activities, groups or places in Tromsø that are suitable for someone my age and preferably low-cost?

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Information Disclosure Vulnerability
items.body:
A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to view sensitive information in clear text on an affected system. This vulnerability is due to insufficient access control enforcement for specific template types that are not included in the encryption allowlist. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability by viewing logs on the local system or on a remote logging server. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view sensitive authentication credentials, which could lead to further compromise of network infrastructure and connected services. Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. There are no workarounds that address this vulnerability. This advisory is available at the following link: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-sdwan-infodis-SPuJBDCe
Security Impact Rating: Medium
CVE: CVE-2026-20294

items.title: CVE-2026-8037 · Progress LoadMaster: Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
items.body:
Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

Tiltak: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

Frist (US federal): 2026-08-10

https://community.progress.com/s/article/LoadMaster-Critical-Security-Bulletin-June-2026-CVE-2026-8037-CVE-2026-33691
BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk
Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk

items.title: Trafikk · Breivikeidet (Tromsø)
items.author: Troms politidistrikt
items.body: Utrykningspolitiet har gjennomført en fartskontroll på Breivikeidet i 60-sonen. 34 bilfører fikk forenklet forelegg for å ha kjørt for fort. 2 bilførere blir anmeldt og det er tatt beslag i førerkort.

items.title: skuffet over plantesesongen :(. hva synes dere?
items.author: Accomplished_Rice_60
items.body:
plantet grønnkåll rett før juni, men har vokst så sakte :(, bladbetene også.... ruccolaen har bare vokst som det da! reddikene bra.

plantet også vårløk white lesbon som jeg også er missfornøyd med :(. tror kanskje jeg har vært litt dårlig på gjødsel siden regnet hver dag? xD, eller bare at det har vært kaldt og lite sol? eller begge delene?

har ikke smakt pipeløk og hørt at det vokser mye fortere en vårløk og flerårig veks, og smaker litt midlere vårløk som er bra!

så er fornøyd med ruccola, reddiker, asiasalat og resten ganske missfornøyd med :(. tenker ikke å plante rotgrønnsaker da siden det tar ganske lang tid og billig i buttiken, men hva tenker dere rundt rotgrønnsaker?

tenker neste år så går jeg all inn på reddiker, ruccola, løpestikke, pipeløk, gressløk, mynte, orgeno, timian? sitronmelisse. høres det bra ut?

items.title: Voldshendelse · Tromsø
items.author: Troms politidistrikt
items.body: Mann slått ned i Grønnegata. Gjerningspersonen forlot i en taxi før vi ankom stedet. En politipatrulje sporet opp taxien i Breivika og fikk raskt kontroll på gjerningspersonen, en mann i 20-årene. Blir anmeldt for kroppskrenkelse. Fornærmede ble ikke alvorlig skadet. Foranledningen til voldsutøvelsen er foreløpig ikke kjent, men det skal ikke ha vært noen relasjon mellom partene.
